name: Radio Button
description: Radio buttons let people select one option from a set of options. Only one radio can be selected in a group at a time.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the radio button is selected

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the radio button is disabled

props.name: required
props.description: Whether selection is required. If any radio in a group is required, all are implicitly required

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted with the form when checked

props.name: name
props.description: The HTML name for form submission and grouping radios

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the radio state changes from user interaction

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the radio receives input

keyboardSupport.action: Move focus to/from the radio group
Move selection within vertical radio group
Move selection within horizontal radio group

accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Place radios inside role="radiogroup" with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Each radio needs aria-label. Do not wrap radios inside label elements.
accessibility.focusManagement: Arrow keys move focus and selection within the group. Only the selected radio or first radio receives Tab focus.

llm.intent: Select one option from a mutually exclusive set
antiPatterns: Too many radio options (use select instead)
llm.semanticMeaning: Single selection from mutually exclusive options
